Still in slices, progressively, beside feature work, never one broad sweep. Fable plans; a model such as Opus 5.5 executes a slice from its brief. Planning, the division of work, the definition of work items and every roadmap change stay in the coordinator lane; a work lane executes and does not plan (D-WORKFLOW-189, 2026-10-23). The plan for the plan is `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` (#346).

## Former body — historical

The whole codebase reviewed adversarially over the fork's releases, in places and progressively, never as one broad sweep (D-WORKFLOW-083 as refined by D-WORKFLOW-102). Acceptance: every slice the ordering analysis (#346) names has its audit folder under docs/audits/ with both council seats' packets, tools/lint-audit-artifacts PASS and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; a release waits only for the findings in the code it changes and for any known security, state-preservation or launch-path finding.

body:
The T5 audit of the build engine (#652, area epic #800, renovation #339). This covers 242 paths: `scripts/`, `config/`, `distributions/ROCKNIX/`, the `Makefile`, the `Dockerfile` and 19 upstream workflows. They were read at `8ebaf8daad`, and `reviewed-at` is `46f6c7d428`, whose slice bytes are identical. Nothing was built. Each claim rests on one of:
- a reading at the site;
- a sandboxed call with its `bash -x` trace read (P1 to P8, P12 to P14);
- an M7 install tree (P7) or recorded run (P10, P11).

The depth is Extended: GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI, `max`) and Gemini 4 Argon (Google, `high`) each ran a refutation pass, and their items are graded in `04-analysis.md` § Second opinion.

**25 findings in 26 items:** 0 Critical, 2 High, 7 Medium, 17 Low.
- **High:** PL-01 (F-16, `mkimage` reports success over an incomplete image on SM8550's route) and PL-02 (F-25, a git cache directory the build user cannot enter makes `get_git` run `git clean -fdx` in the build tree).
- **`bug` issues:** the ten verifiable defects each have one, #827 to #836.
- **Deferred:** seven items go to a named issue (#651, #657, #652).
- **Upstream:** ten items are upstream's code and are #585 candidates; submission is deferred under D-WORKFLOW-165.

**Folder:** [`docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-build-engine/`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/feature/m6-build-engine-652/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-build-engine). The punch list is [`05-punch-list.md`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/feature/m6-build-engine-652/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-build-engine/05-punch-list.md), and the analysis is [`04-analysis.md`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/feature/m6-build-engine-652/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-build-engine/04-analysis.md).

**Stage:** E done (streams E1 to E8 and E5b, each handed back and accepted on #652); every item is at a Phase 7 outcome: 19 Resolved, 7 Deferred to a named issue. A Resolved item whose proof also has a `fix-pending-image` half says so in its line; that half is the first image after the integration.

## Items

- [x] **PL-01** (High, Q3, F-16, #827): the acceptance check in `05-punch-list.md` § PL-01 passes, and the Phase 7 gate records its outcome with the commit or the issue that shows it.
  - Phase 7: **Resolved**, `cfd5ee7324` (E1): every part1 copy, the hook's fifteen, the partitioning, `pigz` and the checksum through `show_error`; a size check; the partial image removed on failure or interrupt.   - Phase 7: **Resolved**, `6712ae5ef3` (E2): `pushd` and `_clean_repo` checked on their own lines, every return pops; a cache directory that cannot be entered is invalid. P17 before and after; proved: fix-sandbox; fix-pending-image: the first build that reuses a warm cache.

  - Phase 7: **Resolved**, `6712ae5ef3` (E2): `HEAD` must equal `git rev-parse "${PKG_VERSION}^{commit}"`; `_clean_repo` resets tracked edits. P16 before and after; proved: fix-sandbox; fix-pending-image: the first build that reuses a warm cache.
